name: Taimasenki Ayane ~Chijoku Saimin no Wana~
original_name: 対魔戦姫アヤネ～恥辱催眠の罠～
source:
Tokyo, a diabolic city that prosper while demons and taimasenki continue the fierce fight against each other...

Ayane and her unique colleagues are strong enough to overwhelm demons.
However, Kashiwagi, an ambitious man, lure them into a hypnotic trap...

Can they escape from the strong hypnosis and counterattack Kashiwagi and Levi, the diabolic princess who controls demons?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE163082.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
东京是一座恶魔横行的城市，恶魔与退魔战姬持续展开激烈斗争……

绫音和她独特的同伴们强大到足以压倒恶魔。然而，野心勃勃的柏木把她们诱入催眠陷阱……

她们能摆脱强力催眠，反击柏木以及支配恶魔的邪恶公主莉薇吗？

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE163082.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
